'''Tatoes''' were one of a few foods able to be harvested by [[hydroponics station]]s on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]] would often include them in her [[Stew/Legends|stews]].
